title: A refreshed home for Monsta Melodic
excerpt: Explore the new look, meet the team and follow our updates in one place.
body: Our website has a new look. You can explore the member roster, meet the people behind the project, and catch news from the monster cave in one place.
Volunteer applications are still open for creative, production, management and community roles. Take a look at the volunteer page if you would like to get involved.

title: Welcome to the Monsta Melodic website
excerpt: A new home for updates, people and everything happening in our little monster universe.
body: Welcome to the official home of Monsta Melodic. This site is where you can meet the team, find project updates and see how to get involved.
We’re an independent NYC/NJ alt idol project with a love of music, myth and all things a little monstrous.
